traits.name: Chameleon Skin.
traits.text: The troglodyte has advantage on Stealth checks made to hide.

traits.name: Stench.
traits.text: Any creature other than a troglodyte that starts its turn within 5 ft. of the troglodyte must succeed on a DC 11 CON save or be poisoned until the start of its next turn.

actions.name: Multiattack.
actions.text: The troglodyte makes three attacks: two with its bite and one with its claws.

actions.name: Bite.
actions.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage.

actions.name: Claws.
actions.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) slashing damage.
